title: AI Development Engineer
jobDescription:
Gurugram | Full-Time About the

ROLE:
We are looking for smart, curious freshers to join as AI Development Engineers.
You should have strong Python skills and a basic understanding of Generative AI and ML concepts/tools. This role is perfect for someone eager to build a career in AI and work on production-grade applications across industries. Compensation: 8-12 LPA (Fixed) Eligibility Criteria: B.Tech (2025 or 2026 pass-out) in Computer Science, AI, IT or related disciplines. JEE Main Common Rank List (CRL) Rank under 50,000. What You’ll Do: Build and deploy software components for AI products Work with Python, APIs, and modern web frameworks Assist in data processing and model integration tasks Collaborate with senior engineers and founders Learn AI concepts and contribute to production-ready applications What We’re Looking For: Strong programming skills in Python Basic understanding of APIs, databases, and web apps Curiosity to learn AI tools and workflows Problem-solving mindset and eagerness to grow Strong analytical skills and the ability to tackle complex problems Good communication skills and the ability to work well in a collaborative environment Why Join Us: Opportunity to work with a passionate and driven team on impactful projects. Access to mentorship and professional development to kickstart your career. Hands-on experience with real-world projects in a supportive and collaborative work environment. Exposure to cutting-edge AI and software development technologies.

title: Campus Recruitment Drive 2027
jobDescription:
Inteligen AI is conducting its 4th Campus Recruitment Drive for students who want to work on cutting-edge AI systems from Day
1. We are a fast-growing AI product studio building enterprise-grade AI solutions across Agentic AI, document intelligence, advanced RAG systems, automation workflows, and production-ready Gen AI applications. Unlike traditional internships or training-first programs, this campus hiring initiative is designed for students who want ownership, fast learning, and exposure to meaningful engineering challenges early in their careers. If you enjoy solving hard problems, learning rapidly, and building products that are actually used by enterprises, you will fit right in here. The environment is fast-paced, hands-on, and designed for people who enjoy solving hard problems and growing through real responsibility. Note: This application form is for the graduating batch of engineering colleges applying through their placement cells. responsibilities simultaneously where you will be challenged every day. If you’re looking for a 9-to-5 role, this may not be the right fit. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own the backend from design to deployment, ensuring systems are secure, scalable, and production-ready Develop and optimize RESTful or Graph QL APIs using Node.js, Python, or Java Architect and manage cloud-native solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP Collaborate on containerization, deployment (Docker), and CI/CD pipelines Set up and manage scalable deployment pipelines and infrastructure automation Lead architecture reviews, enforce best practices and maintain technical excellence across the team Mentor and guide engineers- reviewing code, unblocking challenges and elevating overall engineering quality Take responsibility for delivery timelines and ensure systems meet performance, security and compliance standards Must have skills: Minimum 4 years of hands-on backend development experience Strong proficiency in one or more backend languages: Node.js, Python or Java Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP or Azure) and serverless deployment practices Proven ability to build secure, scalable APIs and microservices Familiarity with streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka) Solid experience with SQL and No SQL databases Experience integrating ML models or working with data-heavy systems is a plus Self-starter mindset- ability to independently manage projects, make decisions, and deliver outcomes from day 1 Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

EDUCATION:
B.Tech (in CS/IT or from Tier 1 institution) No MBA (or non-technical education) No career gap for exam (UPSC etc.) preparation If you’re passionate about building real products, solving meaningful problems, and growing your skills alongside a high-performing team, we’d love to hear from you. closed AI Solutions Architect Gurugram | 3-7 years of experience | Full-Time About the

ROLE:
We are looking for a hands-on AI engineer to lead AI solution delivery across our client engagements. This role blends technical leadership with solution architecture and a strong product mindset. You will be at the frontline of AI solution delivery, where you will drive the full product lifecycle from understanding business objectives, designing technical approaches, building POCs to delivering production-grade AI systems. This is not a backseat, “wait for instructions” role. You will work directly with founders, clients, and our growing AI team to shape solutions that make an impact. This role is ideal for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset, a desire to learn and grow constantly and someone who enjoys their work thoroughly. You will be handling multiple responsibilities simultaneously where you will be challenged every day. If you’re looking for a 9-to-5 role, this may not be the right fit. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Understand business problems, translate them into solution architectures and lead end-to-end AI solution delivery Design and deliver production-grade ML/Gen AI systems tailored to real-world use cases Collaborate with clients to identify needs, present solutions and guide implementation Act as a thought partner to the founder and contribute to strategic decisions Lead and mentor a growing AI/Tech team Collaborate with product and design teams to ship AI-driven features that solve real user problems Continuously explore and experiment with cutting-edge Gen AI tools, technologies and frameworks Must have skills: 3-7 years of hands-on experience building AI/ML solutions across domains Proven ability to understand business workflows and design relevant AI solutions Strong knowledge of Gen AI and experience building scalable applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, and embedding models Proficient in Python and familiar with libraries/frameworks such as Lang Chain, Hugging Face Transformers, Open AI APIs, Pinecone/FAISS Solid understanding of data pipelines, data analytics, and ability to take solutions from prototype to production Self-starter mindset- ability to independently manage projects, make decisions and deliver outcomes from day 1 Excellent communication and problem-solving skills Good to have: Open-source contributions or personal Gen AI projects Experience working in startups or fast-paced, tech-first organizations Experience with MLOps tools Entrepreneurial experience If you’re passionate about building real products, solving meaningful problems, and growing your skills alongside a high-performing team, we’d love to hear from you. CLOSED Full Stack Engineer Jodhpur, Rajasthan | 1-3 years of experience | Full-Time Company Description Inteligen AI specializes in building custom AI systems that are secure, scalable and tailored to achieve measurable business outcomes. Operating as strategic tech partners, we focus on creating impactful solutions through custom AI development, including LLMs, agentic systems and automation. Our offerings include frameworks for document intelligence, RAG, fine-tuning and effective AI consulting to define clear use cases. We collaborate with startups and enterprises to design, build and deploy AI solutions that grow with their businesses. About the

ROLE:
This is a full-time on-site role based in Jodhpur for a Full Stack Engineer.
The Full Stack Engineer will design, develop and maintain both front-end and back-end components of web applications, ensuring seamless integration of functionalities. Responsibilities include collaborating with cross-functional teams, writing clean and efficient code, implementing user interfaces with CSS and troubleshooting and resolving technical issues to enhance performance. Qualifications Proficiency in Node.js | React.js | Python | Java (Spring Boot) Experience with AI tools & integrations Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP) Solid understanding of SQL & No SQL databases Ability to design and build solid, scalable backends Hands-on with application deployment & CI/CD Ability to write clean, scalable, maintainable code Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, on-site team environment Bonus: Familiarity with Angular Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own the backend from design to deployment, ensuring systems are secure, scalable, and production-ready Develop and optimize RESTful or Graph QL APIs using Node.js, Python, or Java Architect and manage cloud-native solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP Collaborate on containerization, deployment (Docker), and CI/CD pipelines Set up and manage scalable deployment pipelines and infrastructure automation Lead architecture reviews, enforce best practices and maintain technical excellence across the team Mentor and guide engineers- reviewing code, unblocking challenges and elevating overall engineering quality Take responsibility for delivery timelines and ensure systems meet performance, security and compliance standards If you’re passionate about building real products, solving meaningful problems, and growing your skills alongside a high-performing team, we’d love to hear from you. CLOSED Junior AI Developer Gurugram | 1+ years of experience | Full-Time About the

ROLE:
We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineer who’s hungry to grow, excited to learn by doing, and ready to ship production-grade Gen AI solutions. You should have strong Python skills and working knowledge of Generative AI concepts and tools. This is an ideal role for someone early in their AI career who’s ready to work on production-grade applications across industries. You will collaborate directly with AI developers, founders, and the best of engineering minds. Expect to be challenged daily and to wear multiple hats. If you are looking for a predictable 9-to-5, this isn’t for you. We move fast, stay curious, and build things that matter. Key responsibilities Prototype and productionize AI applications and services Optimize models and pipelines for latency, accuracy, and cost in production settings Implement and fine-tune Generative AI models using open-source and commercial tools Build advanced RAG pipelines, Agentic AI frameworks, and enhance document intelligence pipelines Work on building scalable AI products across multimodal data Actively track developments in the Gen AI ecosystem and experiment with new tools and methods Write clean, testable, and well-documented code Take ownership from ideation to deployment, iterating fast based on feedback Requirements: 1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions Proficient in Python, with working experience using libraries such as Hugging Face Transformers, Lang Chain, and Open AI SDK Experience with retrieval systems: embeddings, vector DBs (like FAISS, Pinecone, or Chroma) Skilled in prompt engineering and chaining techniques for LLM workflows Familiar with web frameworks like Fast API or Flask for serving models or agents Comfortable working with unstructured data formats (PDFs, HTML pages, scanned documents, etc.) Familiarity with agent frameworks (Lang Graph, Crew AI, Auto Gen, etc.) Hands-on experience with cloud-based GPU environments Good to have: Experience working in startups or fast-paced, tech-first organizations. Open-source contributions or personal Gen AI projects. If you’re passionate about building real products, solving meaningful problems, and growing your skills alongside a high-performing team, we’d love to hear from you. CLOSED Data Scientist Gurugram | 3+ years of experience | Full-Time About the

ROLE:
We’re looking for an experienced Data Scientist with proven, hands-on expertise in developing and deploying machine learning solutions across diverse domains and data types . You will focus on turning complex data into actionable insights and scalable ML-powered products- owning the journey from experimentation to production. This role is ideal for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset, a desire to learn and grow constantly and someone who enjoys their work thoroughly. You will be handling multiple responsibilities simultaneously, where you will be challenged every day. If you’re looking for a 9-to-5 role, this may not be the right fit. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own the ML lifecycle- data exploration, feature engineering, model development, validation and production deployment. Build and optimize predictive models, recommendation engines or computer vision/NLP solutions depending on project needs. Applying machine learning techniques for text mining and information extraction based on structured, semi-structured and unstructured data. Experiment with and implement architectures such as CNNs, Vision Transformers, and custom hybrid models. Perform model validation, optimization and error analysis to ensure high performance in production. Translate business requirements into analytical problems and actionable insights. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate models into AI pipelines and applications. Stay updated with emerging research, tools and frameworks- and bring them into practice where relevant. Ensure adherence to data privacy and security standards throughout the development lifecycle. Requirements: Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in data science roles. Strong grasp of machine learning algorithms, statistical modeling and deep learning techniques. Proficiency with Python and libraries such as Num Py, Pandas, Open CV, scikit-learn, etc. Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as Py Torch or Tensor Flow. Exposure to GPU-based training, distributed model training and model deployment best practices. Strong skills in SQL and working with both relational and No SQL databases. Ability to work with unstructured data formats (text, images, audio, etc.). Exposure to cloud platforms and ML deployment workflows. Comfortable working in fast-paced, high-ownership environments. If you’re passionate about building real products, solving meaningful problems, and growing your skills alongside a high-performing team, we’d love to hear from you.
